code:
Provisioned  -- fixed vCores/DTUs, billed whether busy or idle
Serverless   -- auto-scales within a range, auto-pauses when idle,
                billed per second of actual use (General Purpose only)
caption: Serverless trades a cold-start delay for not paying for idle compute.
Creating an elastic pool — a shared compute/storage budget for many databases.

code:
Steady, predictable load on one database?         -> Provisioned
Spiky load, one database, ok with cold starts?     -> Serverless
Many databases, uncorrelated spikes?               -> Elastic pool
caption: A SaaS vendor with one database per tenant is the textbook elastic pool case.

subtitle: Scaling without downtime, and read scale-out.
